{{Quote|They found us.|The monitor|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
A [[human]] '''monitor''' who served the [[Resistance]]<ref name="TLJ" /> as a tactical officer<ref name="TLJ Junior Novel" /> was aboard the [[MC85 Star Cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]]. After the Resistance successfully evacuated the [[planet]], the ''Raddus'' jumped to [[lightspeed]], but was [[Hyperspace tracker|tracked]] through [[hyperspace]] by [[Snoke]]'s [[flagship]], the ''[[Supremacy]]''. The monitor was situated on the command [[bridge]] of the ''Raddus'' and saw the First Order forces on their screens as the enemy [[fleet]] exited [[hyperspace]], and immediately notified [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] that the First Order had found them.

Shortly afterward, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] fired a pair of [[torpedo]]s into the ''Raddus''<nowiki>'</nowiki> starboard [[hangar]], which destroyed all the parked [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|starfighters]] and [[Death|killed]] several [[Resistance pilot]]s. As [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Organa]] and [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar|Ackbar]] ordered the remaining Resistance [[MC85 Star Cruiser|ships]] to move out of range of the First Order's [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyers]], the monitor immediately rushed through the command bridge to get to their station. The command bridge was destroyed shortly thereafter.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's literally, I [sit] on the spaceship and I say three words.|[[Michaela Coel]]|<ref name="Complex">{{WebCite|url=https://www.complex.com/pop-culture/2017/04/michaela-coel-chewing-gum-netflix-season-2|text=Michaela Coel, The Prodigy Behind Netflix's 'Chewing Gum,' Is The Future of Comedy|author=Maloney, Devon|date=2017-04-07|work=''[[Wikipedia:Complex (magazine)|Complex]]''|quote=But that won't be for long, she was recently cast in the film adaptation of British musical'' Been So Long'', and, she spent a few days on the UK set of the upcoming ''Star Wars'' installment, ''The Last Jedi'', though she refuses to even call it a cameo. "I'm so serious. It's literally, I [sit] on the spaceship and I say three words. And they probably didn't even make the movie."|archiveurl=https://archive.is/U3Xrw}}</ref>}}
The character was portrayed by [[Michaela Coel]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TLJ" /> Coel only did one line for the film and was convinced that her part would be cut from the movie, but it ultimately was not.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2017/12/star-wars-the-last-jedi-cameos-who-is-joseph-gordon-levitt-james-corden-mark-hamill-playing|text=32 Delightful ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' Cameos You Might Have Missed|author=Robinson, Joanna|date=2017-12-17|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|''Vanity Fair'']]|quote=''Chewing Gum'' star '''Michaela Coel''' was reluctant to call her ''Last Jedi'' appearance a cameo. She told Complex earlier this year: "I'm so serious. It's literally, I [sit] on the spaceship and I say three words. And they probably didn't even make the movie." They did! Coel appears as a Resistance monitor who declares "they found us" early on in the film.|archivedate=20171217232113}}</ref>

In the original cut of the film, the Resistance monitor reports to [[Poe Dameron]] when the First Order's forces arrive during an alternate depiction of the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]],<ref name="Deleted scene">{{Film|VIII}}, Deleted Scenes</ref> a scene which was present in both the [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition|adult]]<ref name="TLJ novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> and [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel|junior]] novelizations of the film.<ref name="TLJ Junior Novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> During post-production, the report was edited into the scene where the [[First Order Navy|First Order]] finds the [[Resistance]] after the latter exits [[hyperspace]], although it is still Poe who responds to their report.<ref name="TLJ" />
